name: LNCTU Attendance
tagline: Track classes and view timetable statistics
blurb: LNCTU Attendance is an open-source Android application that fetches attendance data from the LNCTU portal.
description:
LNCTU Attendance is an open-source Android application
that fetches attendance data from the LNCTU portal.

Features:
• Attendance overview
• Subject analysis
• Attendance risk prediction
• Leave planner
• Timetable viewer

This project is not affiliated with LNCT University.
